zh: 新增看板用量能力：已折好的会话用量（每天的四类 token 分桶、按小时的结算次数与各模型总量）经 `dsh-claude-style:usage` 交给看板组件，与工作台首页那块用量面板读同一份缓存；能力注册可以带自己的调用时长上限。
en: Add a widget-board usage capability: the folded session usage (four token buckets per day, settlements per hour and per-model totals) reaches widget cards as `dsh-claude-style:usage`, reading the same cache as the studio home panel; a capability registration can now carry its own call timeout.
